component.title: ResourceCollection
component.purpose: Give resource-heavy products one coherent, recoverable, responsive collection workflow.

states.description: Resources can be searched, refined, selected, and opened.
Refresh preserves the collection context while health is checked.
Saved resources remain useful while freshness is disclosed.
The failed request offers an explicit retry path without discarding filters.
An empty result explains how to recover without pretending the source failed.

claims.statement: The collection controls and results transform with the available container width without horizontal overflow.
Refresh, offline, and request-error states keep the user's collection context available for recovery.
